title: Kurzweil: transcendence through coordination
summary: Biological intelligence (consciousness, creativity, values), artificial intelligence (scale, speed, memory, logical consistency) and neural integration (the interfaces that let them coordinate seamlessly) form a three-body system. Coordinated, the merger expands human capability while preserving consciousness, values and identity; whether it serves human flourishing depends on the coordination architecture we build around it.
source: Ch03 — 'What This Means for Building the Future', Ray Kurzweil's three bodies of transcendence (re-homed from the former chX Kurzweil figure)

nodes.label: Transcendence

nodes.label: Coordination Architecture
nodes.description: Equitable access and alignment built into the merger

edges.description: Biological intelligence supplies the consciousness and values to be integrated
Artificial intelligence supplies scale and speed
Seamless coordination turns two kinds of intelligence into one expanded capability
Constitutional coordination architectures keep the integration aligned
and make transcendence serve human flourishing

identifiability_note: Forward-looking: the merger has not happened, so the coordinated and uncoordinated outcomes cannot be compared. The text itself frames the open question as whether the coordination will be architected to serve human flourishing.
